items.name: Lunar occultation of Antares
items.title: 11 Feb 2026 (1 hour away): Lunar occultation of Antares
items.summary: The Moon will pass in front of Antares (Alpha Scorpii), creating a lunar occultation visible from countries and territories including Antarctica, South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, Falkland Islands and Bouvet Island amongst others.
items.note: Event highlight. Low but possible (11° max). Best around 06:40.
